card.name: The word initiating in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The word "initiating" (or its ending "-ating" after "Initi") in phrases like "Before initiating" or "when initiating" in drug label dosing sections.

modes.label: Before/when initiating
modes.description: The word initiating after "before" or "when" in label instructions about starting therapy.
modes.example: Regularly evaluate such patients, particularly when<< initiating>> and titrating APADAZ and when

modes.label: Heading Initi-ating
modes.description: The final piece of "Initiating" in a section heading before a drug name.
modes.example: 2.1 Recommended Evaluation Before Initi<<ating>> VORANIGO Before initiating VOR

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: Occasional word-internal pieces such as a number in I 131 or the start of nodules.
modes.example: Patients with thyroid<< nod>>ules noted on physical examination or neck imaging
